sources.title: John Deere
sources.snippet: Deere & Company, is an American corporation that manufactures agricultural machinery, heavy equipment, forestry machinery, diesel engines, drivetrains used in heavy equipment and lawn care equipment.
Explore agricultural, construction, forestry machinery, technology, services and more. Find a John Deere dealer in your area or purchase online.
